[SWS_EM_01310]
{OBSOLETE}
Get Activation Time
⌈
Execution Management
shall provide an API
ara::exec::DeterministicClient::GetActivation-
Time
which returns an
ara::exec::DeterministicClient::TimeStamp
that
represents the point in time when the current
kRun
cycle was activated by
ara::
exec::DeterministicClient::WaitForActivation
(see [SWS_EM_01301]).
Deterministic means, that the timestamps are identical for
processes
which are exe-
cuted redundantly. Subsequent calls within a cycle shall always return the same value.
⌋
(RS_EM_00053, RS_EM_00113)
